opis:
A coming-of-age novel for grown-ups about growing up, memory and a time that has vanished but still shapes us.

Summer 1980, the first after Tito's death and the last carefree one. Somewhere in Styria lies Boguizanogu, a half-rural settlement that a motorway, built by republic decree, has cut off from the town.

The young hero and his gang spend the holidays far from the eyes of adults: they ride ponies and motorbikes, smoke in secret, explore forbidden corners, test their courage and feel things for the first time that they cannot yet name. All the while they try to prove they can be cool, even when circumstances push them to the margins.

Across thirteen chapters their adventures slowly reveal the story of a time when the idea of Tito's Yugoslavia begins to fade, something the children do not yet understand but already sense. Told with humour and nostalgia, full of small details and everyday language, it is both local and universal. Published in Slovenian.
